target.name: Operator ID
target.reasoning: Targets by ARIA role "textbox" + accessible name "Operator ID", not a CSS/XPath selector - the accessibility tree is exposed by the browser/OS directly and survives this app's markup changes better than a selector tied to its table-based layout.
